verdict.rationale: Steel's own docs include dedicated integration pages for the Claude Agent SDK (in-process MCP tools), the Vercel AI SDK, and CrewAI (exposed as a CrewAI tool). They also cover further frameworks such as the OpenAI Agents SDK, AgentKit and Pydantic AI, so documented framework adapters are clearly a first-party capability. missing for 10: a documented LangChain adapter (one of the four named frameworks), independent or hands-on corroboration that the adapters work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters

citations.quote: The Steel integration exposes a cloud browser as in-process MCP tools, so the SDK runs the agent loop and Steel handles the browser.
The Steel integration runs each tool against a Steel cloud session (open, navigate, snapshot, extract, return typed results)
The Steel integration exposes a Steel browser as a CrewAI tool, so your crew can search, navigate, fill forms, extract data, and validate results across collaborating agents.
The Steel integration runs each tool against a Steel cloud session, so you can stand up a typed browser agent that opens a session, navigates, extracts data, and returns
